objective: Compare the original independent aspect-sentiment pair formulation with a true aspect-first formulation under a matched Level 2 validation contract.
provenance: Sequential architecture comparison requested after supervisor discussion; capped-two sentiment decoding was frozen as the default before this run.

data_contract.training_filter: remove every official training row containing the fold's held-out aspect
data_contract.validation_rows: the same complete official validation row set for both architectures in every fold
data_contract.representation: name_and_description for every seen and held-out aspect in both architectures
data_contract.threshold_selection: architecture-specific thresholds selected only on seen-aspect validation labels using the same end-to-end pair micro-F1 objective and deterministic tie-breaks

one_stage.task: independently score all 36 aspect-sentiment candidates per review
one_stage.tfidf_training: the original deterministic 4096-pair budget and negative-sampling contract, with candidate text rerendered to name_and_description before fitting
one_stage.decoder: emit every pair whose independent score reaches the seen-validation-selected pair threshold

two_stage.aspect_task: independently score presence for all 12 aspects per review
two_stage.sentiment_task: score three sentiments conditionally for each aspect
two_stage.aspect_decoder: emit every aspect whose presence score reaches the seen-validation-selected aspect threshold; aspect output is uncapped
two_stage.primary_sentiment_decoder: always emit top-1 sentiment and add the runner-up only when it reaches a second-sentiment threshold selected on seen-aspect validation; never emit a third sentiment
two_stage.diagnostic_sentiment_decoder: top-1 sentiment argmax for each selected aspect

comparisons.diagnostic: one_stage_independent_pairs versus two_stage_argmax, and two_stage_capped_two versus two_stage_argmax

primary_metric: held-out pair micro-F1, unweighted mean across the twelve folds
secondary_metrics: held-out pair micro precision and recall
stopping_rules: held-out validation labels entering any parameter or threshold selection
validation row identity mismatch between architectures
more than two sentiments emitted for one selected aspect in the primary two-stage decoder
reporting_rule: Report every method and decoder, including negative results, as sequential validation evidence; do not use held-out outcomes to change this protocol.
